notes: Tuition: the pages state the programme has no tuition fees for all students; the semester contribution (approx. 350 EUR) is not a tuition fee. Intakes: the only dated deadlines given are for the April 2027 summer-semester start; the same pages also show a second deadline block for applicants with a German qualification (E-Campus, December 1st, 2026 until January 15th, 2027), which does not apply to this applicant. No document list for this programme is stated on the supplied pages; the general THM bachelor application page lists documents only for the enrolment stage and for German-language/bilingual programmes, so no documents fact is included.
